messages:
taylor_infra: FYI — need approval to purchase reserved GPU capacity for Q3 eval clusters in us-west-2. Rough ask: ~$120k all-in for 12 months to add 24 A10G GPUs (inference/eval pool). Short timeline: finance + eng-leads sign-off by EOD Wed. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jess-finance: Can you paste the cost breakout and what baseline we're replacing? Need line items (instance, network, one-time infra) and how this is budgeted vs R&D vs infra ops.

taylor_infra: Sure — quick summary:
- Current baseline: 8 on-demand A10G for eval (avg ~60% util) = ~$0.45/hr each -> monthly ~$2.6k total
- Proposed steady state: 24 reserved A10G with 1yr commitment => effective ~$0.18/hr each after commit discount -> monthly ~$3.1k total (for the reserved portion)
- One-time infra (peering, NAT/elastic IPs, setup) = ~$6k
- If we fully replaced same capacity with on-demand for 12 months it'd cost ~ $185k. Committing for 1yr brings it down to ~ $120k (savings ~35% vs on-demand scaling).
- Phased option: start with 8 reserved + 16 on-demand burst -> ~ $45k initial commit impact (12mo pro-rated).
(see internal workbook: https://redwood.intranet/finance/gpu-capacity-q3 )

ajay-ml: Quick Q — why A10G and not A100/H100? What's the perf tradeoff for our evals?

maria-ops: For these eval workloads A10G hits better cost-per-inference (most models run int8/qat). We don't need full FP32 throughput. Also H100 quotas are tight in our primary regions right now. Cross-region egress to eu-central raises cost and latency for test traffic.

samir-eng: From platform POV can we phase it: 8 reserved immediately, then move additional 8->16 reserved if we see stable util>70% for 2 weeks? That cuts initial spend and reduces risk.

taylor_infra: Exactly my suggestion — phased rollout: 8 reserve + 16 on-demand bursts. Monitor util, autoscale rules, and then convert additional on-demand to reserved if utilization justifies. Reduces 12mo commit to ~ $45k up-front.

jess-finance: Phased plan sounds reasonable. Need formal approval from VP Finance + VP Eng. @claire_vp-finance can you review? Also, confirm vendor commit TERM and cancellation windows.

claire_vp-finance: I can provisionally greenlight the phased 8-reserve plan and allocate up to $50k from the R&D headcount pool for this quarter. Approve pending legal review of the contract terms and a two-month usage checkpoint.

legal-bot: Heads-up: vendor contracts require SOC2 addendum for dedicated/reserved capacity and standard 30-day notice for cancellations. I'll route the master services addendum to contracts and loop in legal for sig.

maria-ops: I'll open the Jira req INFRA-8421 and attach the cost workbook + expected tagging plan. Will also add a Grafana dashboard and an alert at 65% util so we can trigger conversion.

taylor_infra: Thanks — I'll post the JIRA link and the detailed cost sheet in here in about an hour. Holding for final sign-off from @claire_vp-finance before we click purchase.

jess-finance: :thumbsup: noted.
